'for {X}' is a duration everywhere else in this same tree (ignites the ground for {Y}, lasts for {X}, stay Cursed for {Y}), but the Arabic reads it as an amount (بمقدار). If {X} is a time value the line states the wrong mechanic.

'Biohunter' names the skill that hunts biological SAMPLES (its description: permanent damage increase against enemies she Biosamples). صائدة الأوبئة means 'plague/epidemic huntress' — a different concept.

The skill's own effects are Stasis stacks plus splash damage when the Biosampler latches on — 'Seizure' is the medical/convulsive sense. الاستحواذ means acquisition/takeover (economic register) and does not match the effect text.
'mitigation' is rendered تخفيف in the four sibling Exoshell/Fortress rows of this same tree but مقاومة (resistance) here — two different mechanics to a reader comparing nodes.
